title: One Warehouse Deal in Six Is Now Someone Handing Space Back
subtitle: Subleasing has risen to a 16% share of the Moscow warehouse market as retailers cut growth programmes, including 63,000 square metres released in the south of the city.

source.name: Moscow warehouse market transactions reported by Kommersant

data.label: Sublease share of the Moscow warehouse market

primaryMetric.label: Sublease share of the Moscow warehouse market

supportingFacts.label: Released in southern Moscow in two buildings of 38,000 and 25,000 square metres.
Space is returning because retailers are trimming expansion, not because new supply arrived.
Subleasing is now roughly a sixth of the market as tenants shed space contracted in better times.

metadata.keyFinding: Subleasing reached a 16% share of the Moscow warehouse market.
